decision.reasoning_trace: In this shopping session, I filtered out non-speaker items like wall shelves, battery replacements, and cases. I narrowed my consideration to highly-rated portable speakers across various price points. The JBL Pulse 4 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_131) was appealing but expensive for its specs. The INSMY and XENEO options offered good value for budget-conscious buyers, but for long-term durability and sound quality, the JBL renewed products stood out. Comparing the JBL Flip 5 Renewed and the JBL Charge 4 Renewed, the Charge 4 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_013) is the superior choice because for only a $10 price difference, it offers much better battery life and the ability to charge external devices.
